_comment: Committed greedy-decode gold fingerprints for the Metal (MLX) engine. PINNED snapshot oracle: there is no live legacy Metal path to diff against (infer/src/backend/metal was deleted), so the contract is bit-for-bit reproducibility of the MLX forward across refactors. prompt_ids decode to 'The capital of France is' in BOTH the Qwen3.5 and Qwen3.6 tokenizers (shared Qwen vocab); each gold continuation was ANCHORED to upstream mlx_lm greedy (temp=0) on the identical ids at bless time, so it is ground truth, not self-reference. REGENERATE deliberately (METAL_PARITY_BLESS=1) only when a numeric change is intended + reviewed; cite the commit + reason in the wins/ entry. Each entry: model id, prompt token ids, max_new, expected greedy continuation ids, and the FNV-1a fingerprint of those ids (see ConcurrentResult::fingerprint).
